'''Serpent Meat''' is a guaranteed drop from [[Serpent]]s, and drops in quantities of 6-7. It can be cooked on an [[Iron Cooking Station]] to obtain '''Cooked Serpent Meat''' and be eaten or crafted into other foods. == Availability == {{drop table|title=Creature| {{drop row|item=Serpent|0star=6-7|px=70}} |stars=0}} == Usage == === Crafting === ==== For Serpent Meat ==== * {{Item link|Cooked Serpent Meat|nolink=1}} * {{Item link|Coal}}, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long ==== For Cooked Serpent Meat ==== * {{Item link|Serpent Stew}} * {{Item link|Sailor's Bounty}} Unlike most other foods made from meat, Serpent Meat has to be cooked on an Iron cooking station first to be crafted into other foods. == Notes == * Serpent Meat floats. It can remain floating for a considerable period. If the player kills a Serpent during a storm but cannot pick up the meat at the time, return as soon as possible and the meat may still be recoverable. * As [[Serpent Stew]] provides more health and stamina, eating the meat is not ideal unless in excess of it. * The stew's constituent ingredients are easily obtainable, with [[Mushroom]]s able to be foraged from [[Meadows]] and [[Black Forest]]s, while the [[Honey]] can be obtained from [[Beehive]]s. * A player eating Cooked Serpent Meat may want to limit the amount of it they carry, as each one is much heavier than any other foods. {{FoodsNav}} [[ru:Мясо змея]] [[cs:Maso z hada]]

{{infobox item | title = Barley | image = Barley.png | description = A bundle of barley. | id = Barley | type = Seed | source = [[Fuling Village]]s in the [[Plains]] biome.
[[Abandoned Village]] [[Barrel]]s. | usage = Building, Crafting, Farming, Taming | weight = 0.2 | stack = 100 | teleport = Yes | crop = 2 Barley | grow time = {{duration|4000}}-{{duration|5000}} | cultivated = Yes | radius = 0.5 | biomes = [[Plains]] }} '''Barley''' is a material item found in the [[Plains]] biome, in [[Fuling Village]]s as small patches of cultivated land, and inside of [[Loot chest#Plains Chest|Plains Chest]] found in Fuling Villages, [[Fuling Outpost]]s and [[Fuling Ruin]]s, as well as the barrels inside the granary of [[Abandoned Village]]s in the [[Deep North]]. Barley can only be planted and harvested in the [[Plains]] biome, using a [[Cultivator]]. It takes between 4,000 seconds and 5,000 seconds (between 66 minutes 40 seconds and 83 minutes 20 seconds, or about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for it to fully grow. Fully grown Barley will drop two Barley when damaged by weapons. AoE attacks, such as those of the [[Stagbreaker]], [[Iron Sledge]] or [[Polearms|Polearms']] secondary attack can be used. No Barley is lost, however, these methods do not grant experience towards the [[Farming (Skill)|Farming skill]], and the chance of extra yields will not trigger. As such, using a [[Scythe]] or harvesting by hand have potentially better yield. ==Usage== ===Building=== *{{Item link|Straw}} ===Crafting=== *{{Item link|Barley Flour}} via {{Item link|Windmill}} *{{Item link|Barley Wine Base: Fire Resistance}} *{{Item link|Yggdrasil Porridge}} ===Farming=== *2 Barley can be obtained by planting and growing a single Barley using the [[Cultivator]]. ===Taming=== *{{Item link|Lox|size=64px}} *{{Item link|Hen|size=40px}} {{MaterialsNav}} [[Category:Materials]] [[fr:Orge]] [[cs:Ječmen]] [[ru:Ячмень]] [[de:Gerste]] [[uk:Ячмінь]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a type of consumable.

== Description ==
Consuming a Bukeperries gives the [[Feeling sick]] effects.

For 15 seconds, it disables health and stamina regen, halves movement speed, and every 2 seconds it deals 1 damage and undoes one consumed Food.

The effect is useful to remove active food without having to wait past theirs expiration times. It can be used to quickly switch between active foods. However, the removed foods are wasted and the player remains vulnerable during the puke.

== Availability ==
* Drops from [[Fuling Shaman]].
* Drops from [[Greydwarf Shaman]].

== Notes ==
Eating [[Rotten Meat]] has the same effect as eating {{PAGENAME}} and serves as a late game alternative.

==Trivia==
* Bukeperries is [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spoonerism Spoonerism] for "Puke Berries", being a berry that will make you puke.
* Bukeperries, along with the Toadstool, may be an allusion to psychedelics and more specifically ayahuasca, a nauseating psychedelic brew of tree roots the indigenous 'magic men' or shamans of South America used to receive messages from the transmundane, as ayahuasca is notorious for making the consumer vomit and only shaman type enemies drop them.

'''Egg''' is an item and a food source, which can be initially purchased from [[Haldor]] to be able to breed [[Chicken]]s. In order to start a chicken farm, two eggs are required. It can be cooked in a [[Cauldron]] to obtain a '''Cooked egg'''. == Availability == * Purchased from [[Haldor]] for {{Item link|Coins|1500}} after defeating [[Yagluth]]. * Found in a chest in the bottom floor of the [[Sealed Tower]] structure in the [[Plains]]. * Naturally spawns if two [[Hen]]s are well-fed, sheltered, and near each other. == Usage == === Crafting === * {{Item link|Cooked egg}} * {{Item_link|Unbaked Sweetbread}} * {{Item link|Mushroom Omelette}} * {{Item_link|Pancakes}} === Hatching === An egg must be placed (dropped from inventory) near a fire or heat source and under a roof (needs shelter) to hatch. When hovering over an egg, it will indicate whether it is too cold to hatch (note: hovertext may take 5-10 seconds to update). After 30 minutes, the egg will hatch, and a [[Chicken]] will spawn and will eventually grow into a [[Hen]]. The egg must be placed individually - not in a stack - to hatch. Don't place it TOO close to the fire or it'll immediately die after hatching. == See also == * [[Taming#Breeding|Breeding]] {{FoodsNav}} [[ru:Яйцо]] [[cs:Vejce]]

'''Berserkir mead''' is a [[Plains]]-tier consumable item [[Fermenter|fermented]] from '''Mead base: Berserkir'''. == Recipe == ''Mead base: Berserkir'' is produced in a [[Mead Ketill]] with: * {{item link|Mushroom|10}} * {{item link|Yellow Mushroom|10}} * {{item link|Toadstool|1}} Three ''Berserkir meads'' are produced by [[Fermenter|fermenting]] the mead base for two in-game [[Day and Night Cycle|days]]. == Effect == Consuming it grants a reduction to attack, block and dodge stamina use by -80% for 20 seconds, but it makes the player weak (x1.5) against [[Slash]], [[Blunt]] and [[Pierce]] damage. ==Tips== * Because of how [[Resistance#stacking|resistance stacking]] works - in that being Resistant overrides being Weak - the [[Bonemass#Forsaken_power|Bonemass power]] will prevent the negatives of this potion and instead leave the player with resistance to Slash, Blunt and Pierce while preserving the benefits of the potion. * There is no cooldown on Berserkir mead, so you can quaff one every 20 seconds, giving you the chance to use 15 Berserkir meads during one Bonemass duration. {{FoodsNav}} [[ru:Медовуха берсеркира]] [[cs:Berserkská medovina]]
